reason: Solar Industries India Limited is proposing to acquire Omnia Holdings Limited, which could expand its market reach and product offerings.
why_now: The company issued a press release on September 14, 2026, detailing the proposed acquisition.
source_headlines: Solar Industries India Limited: Solar Industries India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated September 14, 2026, titled "Press release on proposed acquisition of Omnia Holdings Limited by Solar SA Investments Proprietary Limited".
